say:2:1041573401:1.text: Good evening, milady. There don't seem to be many open seats. May I join you?
say:2:1041573401:1.source_cn: 晚上好，女士。这里难得有空位，介意与我分享这张桌子吗？

say:3:1041573402:1.text: From your armor and bearing... you've seen many battles, haven't you? Are you a knight?
say:3:1041573402:1.source_cn: 看你的铠甲和姿态，是位身经百战的骑士？

say:4:1041573403:1.text: You may sit. Knight was my title, two thousand years ago.
say:4:1041573403:1.source_cn: 坐吧。骑士，那是两千年前我的身份了。

say:5:1041573404:1.text: Your eye is sharp. You carry a knight's bearing yourself.
say:5:1041573404:1.source_cn: 你的观察很敏锐，你身上，同样具有骑士的气息。

say:6:1041573405:1.text: Haha, yours is sharper still. I am Silven, of House Grenvalden.
say:6:1041573405:1.source_cn: 呵呵，你的眼光更为准确。我出身于格伦沃顿家族，我叫休。

say:7:1041573406:1.text: Grenvalden... A descendant of Alistair Grenvalden?
say:7:1041573406:1.source_cn: 格伦沃顿……亚利斯塔·格伦沃顿的后人？

say:8:1041573407:1.text: You know my ancestor?! Yes, he defended the Empire during the First Divine War!
say:8:1041573407:1.source_cn: 您听说过先祖？！是的，他曾在第一次神魔战争中守护帝国！

say:9:1041573408:1.text: But now... I walk the path of a mage instead.
say:9:1041573408:1.source_cn: 但现在……我走在成为魔法师的道路上……

say:10:1041573409:1.text: You set aside sword and scabbard, and take up a staff?
say:10:1041573409:1.source_cn: 放弃铠甲剑鞘，选择法杖？

say:11:1041573410:1.text: To restore a family reduced to a name alone... one must wield both power and influence.
say:11:1041573410:1.source_cn: 复兴一个只剩空壳的家族，需要更直接的力量和关注度。

say:12:1041573411:1.text: Magic is the more realistic path.
say:12:1041573411:1.source_cn: 选择魔法是更现实的路。

say:13:1041573412:1.text: Glory has always demanded its price.

say:14:1041573413:1.text: Alistair forged his renown with the blood of his comrades... and his own.
say:14:1041573413:1.source_cn: 昔日，亚利斯塔用战友与自己的鲜血，铸就了显赫的声名。

say:15:1041573414:1.text: I never imagined his line would one day falter so.
say:15:1041573414:1.source_cn: 没想到他的后人，如今这般艰难。

say:16:1041573415:1.text: You speak as one who understands the cost of war.
say:16:1041573415:1.source_cn: 你似乎对战争的代价深有体悟？

say:17:1041573416:1.text: In the records I studied, a heroine and her soldiers paid dearly to defeat the Frost Furie...
say:17:1041573416:1.source_cn: 我研读过历史卷册，在第一次神魔战争中，有一位女英雄和她...

say:18:1041573417:1.text: The victory was won, yet countless lives were lost along the way.
say:18:1041573417:1.source_cn: 所幸最终结果尚能接受，不过客观而言，的确有无数生命因此逝去。

say:19:1041573418:1.text: Tell me, Silven. If restoring your family meant dragging your companions into poverty, hunger... even death... would you still persist?
say:19:1041573418:1.source_cn: 你说想重振家族，若你，甚至牵连同伴，要为此付出沉重的代...

say:20:1041573419:1.text: I... I can't give you a definite answer yet.
say:20:1041573419:1.source_cn: 我……我现在还不能给出确切的回答……

say:21:1041573420:1.text: But I'll fight with magic to the very end, and I'll never betray a knight's honor!
say:21:1041573420:1.source_cn: 但至少，我会用魔法争取一切，绝不背叛骑士的信义，这是我...

say:22:1041573421:1.text: You have my respect. May the glory of the Grenvalden name one day rise again.
say:22:1041573421:1.source_cn: 深感敬佩。愿格伦沃顿的荣光终能重现。
